integrity: Analytic proof and reproducible exact-fraction checks supplied. Exact grid testing is illustrative rather than a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is a one-shot incentive comparison with an exogenously recruited, one-epoch-at-minimum vacancy and permanent ineligibility of the exploited delegate; it is not a Nash equilibrium or empirical causal inference. Publication priority is not independently established.
title: Re-entrant exit accountability with a finite recruitment pool
